statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of the response actually served. Recon found one error-like static archetype and no internal routes or flows; robots, sitemap, and a missing-route response were additionally inspected.

page.notes: The origin returns HTTP 200 with a 16-byte body containing only “*** BAD PAGE ***”. No bot challenge or auth wall was shown.

paths.description: Public entry response, the only discovered content archetype. It was audited at desktop/mobile and preference conditions; no navigation or primary flow exists. robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and a representative missing route were checked as supporting global/error surfaces. No additional content templates could be covered because the entry DOM contains no links and sitemap.xml is absent.

findings.summary: The public entry page exposes no product content or primary action.
findings.evidence: Desktop, mobile, raw, and rendered captures show only “*** BAD PAGE ***”; the DOM contains no heading, link, button, or form.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore the intended page response first. Return a semantic main landmark with a descriptive h1, concise purpose, and one clear primary action instead of the placeholder failure text.

findings.summary: The page ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The default and dark-emulated screenshots are equivalent; CSS inspection found no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use system colors or light-dark() for page surfaces and text once the intended UI is restored.

findings.summary: Mobile browsers receive a desktop-width layout viewport.
findings.evidence: At 360x800, layout metrics report a 980px viewport scaled to 0.367 because meta viewport is absent; Lighthouse flags viewport optimization.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and build the restored content with intrinsic/fluid sizing that reflows at narrow widths.

findings.summary: No primary download or navigation flow can be started.
findings.evidence: The rendered DOM has zero links, buttons, forms, or other focusable controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore the intended end-to-end user journey with a real href or semantic control for the primary action, predictable steps, and no dead ends.

findings.summary: Failure states are unexplained and unrecoverable.
findings.evidence: The root returns HTTP 200 with “*** BAD PAGE ***” and no action; unknown paths return a generic Apache 404 with no route back.
findings.suggestedFix: Return an appropriate error status for failures and render an accessible error message with explanation, retry, home, and support/recovery actions.

findings.summary: The document has no semantic structure or keyboard path.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no main landmark; the DOM probe finds no headings, landmarks, links, controls, or focusable elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Structure the restored page with header/nav/main/footer landmarks, a logical heading hierarchy, and semantic keyboard-focusable actions with visible focus.

findings.summary: The entry document omits a doctype and renders in quirks mode.
findings.evidence: DOM reports doctype null and compatMode BackCompat; Lighthouse fails its doctype audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Start the response with <!doctype html> and retain an early UTF-8 charset declaration in a valid document head.

findings.summary: The public endpoint provides none of the basic discovery or sharing signals.
findings.evidence: There is no title, description, viewport, canonical, link, JSON-LD, or Open Graph metadata; sitemap.xml is 404 and the broken root returns 200.
findings.suggestedFix: After restoring content, add a unique title and description, canonical URL, crawlable descriptive links, accurate share/schema metadata, and a sitemap; return truthful HTTP statuses.

findings.summary: Browser security headers are absent and the persistent cookie is not Secure.
findings.evidence: Header audit finds no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. SITE_TOTAL_ID is one-year, SameSite=None, and lacks Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy. Mark the cookie Secure and choose Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is required.

findings.summary: The server-rendered baseline preserves only the broken state.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML and JavaScript-enabled rendering both contain only “*** BAD PAGE ***”; crawler and browser screenshots show the same unusable result.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the core page identity, content, navigation, and primary link/action in semantic HTML, then layer JavaScript enhancements on top.

findings.summary: The document language and direction are undeclared.
findings.evidence: The html element has neither lang nor dir; Lighthouse fails html-has-lang.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an accurate html lang value and use dir where needed; build restored layouts with logical properties and translation-ready markup.
